name: The Shadowhound crits, hits and gets past dodges and parries with its owner's ranged stats
contract: Live CoA combat logs show hound crit rates tracking the owner's Auto Shot crit rate (owners at 12-27% while
leveling had hounds at 16-33%, raid owners at 40-50% had hounds at 50-88%), plus hound talents, and live hounds
almost never miss, are dodged or are parried. A creature's own melee crit is 5% and an equal-level target avoids
about 15% of its swings. With fixture ratings that cap the owner's ranged crit, ranged hit and expertise, every
hound swing lands as a crit. Expected: at least 20 swings in 45 s, every one a crit.
